_doc: Zones for the Castle Falls BK size-M benchmark crop (x -180..20, y 365..565 garment mm; x from CB, + = wearer's right; y from the CB neck seam). Hand-authored on 19 Oct 2026 from the 12 ppm reference (mockup + back_left close-up) and its tone trace. A zone is a WINDOW plus the tones that belong to it: the silhouette inside is traced from the input pixels (digitize.extract.zones), never drawn here. Zones claim pixels from the highest z down (ground last = everything left over). splitter: sky -> sky bands, fall -> cords, pool -> pools, cloud -> lobes + shade + wisps (M2), stratum -> bedding bands + cracks (M2), stub -> zone_stub parts (M3 replaces the remaining stubs: buildings, trunks, crowns, florets). Options (M2): except = cut those zones' windows out of this one; close_mm = claim specks of other tones enclosed by this zone's tones.

zones.note: pale haze behind the right-hand blossoms and a sliver at the top edge: the only sky in this crop
the big left fall, from the top of the crop to where foliage covers it
the lower cascade of the left fall, above the blossoms
the centre fall behind the castle
foam where the centre fall lands, over the roof line
cloud bank between the falls (cloud splitter: M2)

M3a: one window per building (temple bottom-left, pagoda, castle centre, houses right, roof line bottom), hand-authored 20 Oct 2026 from the 12 ppm reference; the building splitter fits roofs / walls / eaves / windows / members / studs from the pixels inside. Pixels of non-building tones (foliage, blossom) go back to the zones below; the old whole-area window's foliage, rock and trunks now fall to foliage / cliffs / ground.
every cherry blossom crown and petal in the crop (floret splitter: M3)
pine and shrub crowns over the cliffs (crown splitter: M3); claimed before the cliffs so the rock is what is left
the rock faces (navy / slate facets, tan and mist highlights): stratum splitter (M2), bands along the reference grain; masses under 40 mm2 go to the ground
everything not claimed above: trunks, small rock specks, leftovers (trunk splitter: M3)
